headline: Thirsty for long-term capital, businesses push bond interest rates into double digits
summary: Corporate bond issuance in Vietnam has risen sharply, and bond interest rates have returned to double digits as businesses face high capital-raising pressure in the second half of the year.
why: Corporate bond yields show the cost of debt for businesses and the strain on credit markets, which affects investors in Vietnamese debt and equities.
